import sys

def is_amplifying(line):
    stripped = line.lstrip()
    return stripped.startswith('#') if stripped else False

def process_spell(input_lines):
    output_lines = []
    i = 0
    n = len(input_lines)

    while i < n:
        current_line = input_lines[i]
        is_current_amp = is_amplifying(current_line)

        if is_current_amp:
            output_lines.append(current_line)
            i += 1
        else:
            # Collect all consecutive non-amplifying lines
            temp_lines = []
            while i < n and not is_amplifying(input_lines[i]):
                temp_lines.append(input_lines[i])
                i += 1

            # Concatenate non-amplifying lines without spaces
            concatenated = ''.join(line.rstrip() for line in temp_lines)
            if concatenated:
                output_lines.append(concatenated)

    return output_lines
